QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_59

question.text: Vasant Fund invested INR 40 crore at Year 0 and distributed INR 80 crore at end of Year 5 (single cash flow each). Gross IRR (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: IRR equation: 40 × (1+r)^5 = 80 → (1+r)^5 = 2 → 1+r = 2^(1/5) = 1.1487 → r = 14.87%. The Trap: Option A is simple 10% approx. Option C is simple average. Option B is total return not annualised. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B and X-A/B test IRR; XIX-B for Cat III. Manager's Pro-Tip: When presenting IRR to LPs, also show CAGR on net value and money multiple — LPs cross-check via three methods. A fund with 2x MOIC over 5 years has IRR ~14.87%; this is a common mental benchmark.
